messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for explaining your cost drivers and for your past price support. Rising expenses deserve recognition, though current input changes and earlier margin erosion need separate consideration.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Our packages recognise that distinction and support continued supply. We are flexible on payment terms; which option works best for your foundry?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 131.87 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 131.93 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you and your office manager separate the requested increase into current input-cost changes and recovery of earlier underpricing, using updated actual costs?

We value your family's commitment and want a sustainable agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We have verified your data regarding energy costs and have adjusted our calculation accordingly, as we always strive for fairness between our houses. We appreciate your detailed review and your recognition of our long-standing partnership. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.

To maintain the quality and reliability you expect from our foundry, we propose €135.50 with 30-day payment terms as a sustainable step forward. For our offer, we quote a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for checking the energy data and reducing your offer; your remaining labour and material cost pressures deserve recognition. We also remember your past price support and appreciate your willingness to revisit the calculation.

Your latest offer is still 7.1% above today's price of EUR 126.53.

We are making a modest price concession and ask for a further step from you: Option B gives you your requested standard payment terms in exchange for a lower price. We are flexible on payment terms, with higher prices available for longer payment periods; which option works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 133.56 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 133.05 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 133.38 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our long relationship and want pricing that sustains it.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
